name: This_10
short_caption: The robot extends its left hand slightly forward and outward in a subtle pointing or presenting gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot slightly lifts its left hand, rotating the forearm outward and opening the fingers to face upwards and outwards. It briefly holds this open-handed presenting pose before smoothly retracting the arm back to the neutral hanging position. The head, torso, and right arm remain still throughout the motion.
safety_notes: The robot extends its left arm slightly forward and to the side; ensure no obstructions are immediately adjacent to its left side.
